annotations.text: Class editor/view redesign. Kept as one unified page (matches how the rest of the app already handles view-vs-edit, e.g. character stat panels) rather than splitting into two routes. Restyled into clear sections (Identity, Visibility, Combat Stats, Melee/Ranged Damage with a live formatted preview, Healing, Lore, Actions & Feats), with Actions as collapsible cards instead of an inline sprawl, tags edited via a small popover with a live pill preview instead of raw color swatches, and a sticky save bar instead of a blocking alert(). The pill switcher at the top of the Main artboard is a DEMO-ONLY control for previewing all three states (Visitor / Author / Admin) — the real page still gates by canWrite/ADMIN_UIDS, not a manual toggle.
